title: config responses
description: Standard output of config in JSON mode: showing (CONFIG-015), setting (CONFIG-130), resetting (CONFIG-202), --reload (CONFIG-022), or a refusal. Problems with the settings files and refused values go to standard error (CONFIG-102, CONFIG-118). config is the front end's: the same shape for every backend; only the fields differ.

fields.description: config [<key>]: the fields shown, all of them or the one named (ConfigResponse).

config.description: ConfigEntry: one field, backend first, then the backend's in its order (CONFIG-010). The backend's come from its section of the settings files (COM-131); another backend's section is never listed.

field_name.description: backend, or one of the backend's fields: linux, devicetree, workfile, overlay-syntax, preprocess-command, deploy-ip, deploy-user, deploy-password where the backend is linux; capi-path, module-paths, board, platform, workfile, bootstrap, interview, project-name, project-path, project-template, example, build-command, deploy-command, probe where it is noos (COM-500).

category.description: The group the human table lists it under: General for backend; Workspace and Deploy where the backend is linux; Sources, Target, Workfile, Project and Build where it is noos.

type.description: The kind; a setting with options gives them instead: a fixed list (overlay-syntax, probe; true and false for a noos bool), or the names the backend scans (noos board and platform, which are string when it finds none, CONFIG-510).

value.description: The effective value: local, then global, then the default, a backend's field from its section of each file (COM-124); absolute for a local path; null when it has none.

done.description: config --reload (message: the build summary, CONFIG-022), config <key> <value> (message: Set <key> = <value>, then (global), then the backend's addition, CONFIG-130) or config <key> --reset (message: Reset <key>, then (global), then what applies now, CONFIG-202).

message.pattern: ^(Set [a-z-]+ = .*|Reset [a-z-]+( \(global\))? \((still set in the (local|global) config: .*|default: .+|not set)\)|Indexed [0-9]+ compatibles from [0-9]+ bindings and compiled binding schemas in .+|Nothing to rebuild: .+)$
